title: Test map (.qa/trace/test-map.json)
description: Maps test case IDs to the automated tests that implement them, for projects that do not tag test names. Each entry is a test id in the form results record, classname::name (for example tests.test_discount::test_cap, or tests.test_discount.TestCap::test_cap for a class). qa trace scan also accepts the pytest path form (tests/test_discount.py::test_cap) and normalises it to that form; an entry it cannot map is reported, never guessed.
